name: microbench
caption: Wave 2 microbench: physics × s1 × W=4096 × T=8192 (2 turnovers) × 4 family heads. Shows exclusive-GPU decode tok/s and step latency for S9–S11 wall-clock. Does not start the 12W matrix. Gemma IT failed empty-completion and is not a tok/s source.
alt_text: Wave 2 microbench: physics × s1 × W=4096 × T=8192 (2 turnovers) × 4 family heads. Shows exclusive-GPU decode tok/s and step latency for S9–S11 wall-clock. Does not start the 12W matrix. Gemma IT failed empty-completion and is not a tok/s source.
limitations: Smoke is T=32 / W=32, not a 12W scientific horizon. tok/s on smoke includes a tiny decode and is not the S9 operating point. UMAP is not used. No G_t or lock claim.
